title: Derivative of a biased monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The biased discrete derivative of the biased monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at $x$ in coordinate $i$, equals the biased monomial indexed by $S\setminus\{i\}$ at $x$ if $i\in S$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
